transcript: Speaker A: You need to tell your dad to stop using Siri to send his texts. No, I'm not the only one getting one of these every week. Half of the words are misspelled and the other half you couldn't even find in the English dictionary. Siri doesn't understand context, so it'll often mishear the conversation and include words that he never meant to say. That's why you get the 'Sorry, sent that with Siri' follow-up of shame. You got to get him on Whisper Flow. Check this out. Hey, I'll meet you on Wednesday. Actually, Thursday at 3:30. Oh, no, 4:30. Thanks, miss you, see you then. So you see how it didn't dictate any of the corrections that I had there? And that's because Whisper has an AI that understands the context of what you're actually trying to say. It doesn't pick up on any of your filler words or misspoken sentences like this. Hey, I'll see you on Wednesday. Actually, Thursday at 12:30. No, I mean 1:30. Thanks, love you, bye. See what I mean here? It dictates every word in real-time, so it picks up on all of your filler words and misspoken phrases. Tell him that Whisper Flow is literally free to download, so you can actually understand what he's trying to say when he texts you.

summary: The presenter highlights the frustrations of Siri's inaccurate dictation and introduces Whisper Flow, an AI dictation tool that filters out filler words and self-corrections. He demonstrates its superior accuracy and notes that the app is free to download.
